text:
sam: Heads-up — hotpatch RC cut in ~25m. PR #5234 (kv-cache off-by-one) is the blocker. We need two approvals (owners + perf) before cutoff to merge. @morgan @priya can you take a look? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5234

release-bot: merge window opens in 25 minutes. Automated checks queued: ci/unit, ci/integration, perf-smoke.

morgan: On it, will run a quick perf sanity check on staging. If green I can LGTM.

alex: Ran unit + quick perf locally: median p95 latency baseline 72ms -> patch 74ms. No obvious regression in short run.

priya: Skimming the diff now. My main question: cache invalidation timing looks tight — did you add coverage for the KV edge case?

sam: Added kv/cache_off_by_one_test.go in the PR. CI showed green earlier but integration had a flaky run — fixed the flaky assertion and re-ran. @jen can you give a perf+safety once-over?

jen: I can jump on this in ~10m. If CI stays green and perf smoke is fine, I'll +1. :eyes:

morgan: Verified integration on staging (sanity/kv-warmup). No regressions seen, smoke passed. LGTM. :thumbsup:

priya: I pulled the test and reviewed reasoning around the pointer arithmetic — looks correct now. Seconding LGTM. Recommend merge + 15m monitor window for kv-miss-rate and tail latency.

ops-oncall: I'll watch rollout dashboards (kv-miss-rate, p95 latency, error-rate). Pager is on. Ping me if anything spikes.

sam: Thanks all. release-bot: proceed with merge once both LGTM and all checks remain green.

release-bot: PR #5234 merged by automation at 2214508005. Cutover started. Notifying oncall and updating release tracker.

jen: Noted — running quick smoke tests post-merge. No failures so far.

sam: Closing thread for now. Monitoring for 15m and will post updates if anything unusual shows up. Thanks everyone!
